use: Cinematic lettering and countdown; preserve existing crest and all other artwork
prompts:
Use case: style-transfer / background-extraction.
Asset type: a production transparent raster lettering atlas for the EVOLVE boss warning cinematic.
Input image 1 is the user's approved finished design reference. Transfer its LETTERING, not its monster or composition. The reference is authoritative: closely preserve the specific silver-metal VENOM TITAN glyph shapes, wide compact proportions, sharp angular serif tips, dark chipped steel bevels and restrained green acid hanging from the lower edges. Do not invent a different font or make it more ornate, heavier, taller, rounded or cartoonish. Keep the primary letter faces predominantly pale silver, with fine green details confined to lower cuts and small drips. The reference CONTAINMENT BREACH uses a clean squared industrial metallic block alphabet, WARNING uses narrow red distressed industrial stencil letters, and PHASE / COLOSSAL LIFEFORM use small clean, widely spaced pale-silver industrial letters. Match those distinctions exactly.
Create ONE high-resolution portrait PNG atlas with a real transparent background, arranged in EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS of equal rectangular cells. No visible grid, no panel background, no labels. Every item stays inside its own cell with 8% transparent margins. The final bottom-right cell is completely empty/transparent.
The nine items, in reading order:
row 1 left: "BIO TITAN" — use the same compact silver angular alphabet as the reference VENOM TITAN, restrained small green lower accents.
row 1 right: "VENOM TITAN" — very close visual match to the supplied reference title, on ONE line.
row 2 left: "WARNING" — narrow distressed RED stencil lettering as on the red tape in the reference, lettering only.
row 2 right: "CONTAINMENT BREACH" — TWO lines, CONTAINMENT above BREACH, pale chipped steel squared block lettering as in the reference, left aligned.
row 3 left: "PHASE" — a single row of small clean widely spaced pale-silver industrial capitals like the reference PHASE.
row 3 right: "COLOSSAL LIFEFORM" — one line of small clean widely spaced pale-silver capitals like the reference subtitle.
row 4 left: the single numeral "1"
row 4 right: the single numeral "2"
row 5 left: the single numeral "3"
row 5 right: entirely transparent.
The digits 1, 2 and 3 match the exact broad squared chipped-silver industrial style of the large 2 at the top right of the supplied reference, with subtle green on their lower edges. Matching heights/baselines, no boxes or ornaments.
All text must be spelled exactly. Isolate every wordmark and glyph with crisp opaque edges and true alpha=0 around and inside openings. No faint colored rectangular matte, no fog behind letters, no texture in the transparent gaps. No monster, no crest, no frame, no warning stripes, no UI panels, no numerals attached to PHASE. Preserve the reference look, do not redesign it.
